answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The grove graph is validated at intake and the delta frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and jade anchors the chain at a checkpoint. The cost per fake identity is 84 dollars in collateral plus 7 days of latency, so 1706 identities is a 2 million dollar bet against a mechanism that slashes on failure. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
